name: (Martial Artist, Grandmaster) Solar Surge
text:
The grandmaster unleashes a qi wave as bright as the sun. All creatures within a 50-foot radius of the grandmaster who can see must attempt a DC 38 Reflex save save, including the grandmaster themself.

---
Critical Success The creature is Dazzled for 1 round.

Success The creature is Blinded for 1 round.

Failure The creature is blinded for 1 day.

Critical Failure The creature is permanently blinded.
